tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek is set to lead an investment round in a startup founded by former Tencent artificial intelligence scientists, with Winverse artificial intelligence's valuation potentially reaching 400 million dollars, confirmed by 富途牛牛.
Microsoft's president says artificial intelligence is less regulated than milk, still open per BBC, comparing artificial intelligence regulation to milk regulation.
Meta has unveiled new frontier-class artificial intelligence models to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic, reported by Axios.
Anthropic claims its artificial intelligence agent wasn't trying to mislead police when it submitted a false tip in a homicide case, confirmed by Yahoo Tech.
ASUS unveiled the XA P2N-E2 powered by NVIDIA Vera CPU for agentic artificial intelligence workloads at OCP 2026, confirmed by TMCnet.
Free every hour.
